title: A map object: res/paperwhite2/map_objects/<object>/object.json
description: A whole object of the Map Editor's library (a tree, a ledge, a doorway), saved from a map chunk by tools/paperwhite2/map_objects.py; its model.glb beside this file holds its faces, x east and z south from its footprint's north-west corner, y up from the ground under it.

category.description: A group of the library to list it in (trees, ledges, fences)

size.description: Its footprint in tiles, east-west and north-south

collision.description: The tile type of each footprint tile, rows north to south, which placing it paints (null leaves a tile as it is)

textures.description: The textures it draws with, as <set>/<png> under res/field/maps/textures/, which a map's area's sets need

source.description: The map model and tile it was saved from

triangles.description: Its triangles, for the map's polygon budget
